name: ignored: the bypass (the first version of this change): ignored is enough to leave a file in a package out of the gates
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is still judged by the gates, and is a finding of its own, with a .gitignore beside it"

name: ignored: the bypass, for the lint
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is still linted, with a line in the root .gitignore"

name: ignored: the bypass, for the editor hook's run
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is judged when the editor hook names it"

name: ignored: the bypass, for any tree
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "every file git does not ignore, and every file in a package"

name: ignored: an ignored folder that holds the packages is not left out
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is still judged by the gates, and is a finding of its own, with the folder that holds the packages ignored"

name: ignored: a folder beside the packages is not taken for one
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "does not make a folder beside the packages judged"

name: ignored: a declared package is protected without a workspace file
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is protected in a package the config declares"

name: ignored: a workspace package nothing declares is protected
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is protected in a package the config declares"

name: ignored: the finding is made
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is still judged by the gates, and is a finding of its own, with a line in the root"

name: ignored: the finding is made in the editor hook's run
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is judged when the editor hook names it"

name: ignored: every code file of an ignored folder is found
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is found in an ignored folder of a package"

name: ignored: a generated folder is what a package may ignore
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is not a finding in an installed or generated folder"

name: ignored: a file that is no code is no finding
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is not a finding in an installed or generated folder"

name: ignored: a rule in .git/info/exclude or a global list hides nothing
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "hides nothing when it is in .git/info/exclude"

name: ignored: a global rule hides nothing
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "hides nothing when it is in the person"

name: ignored: a folder ignored from outside is not walked
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is listed whether the root"

name: ignored: the walker leaves such a file out
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is left out by the gates' file walker"

name: ignored: a folder that only begins like an ignored one is walked
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is told from a name that only begins the same way"

name: ignored: a file that only begins like an ignored one is listed
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is told from a name that only begins the same way"

name: ignored: the editor hook's run judges no ignored file outside a package
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is not judged when the editor hook names it either"

name: ignored: a name a glob would read as a pattern is taken literally
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "makes each pattern a path git listed"

name: ignored: a folder's pattern covers what is under it
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "makes each pattern a path git listed"

name: ignored: the lint gets what git ignores, as git reads a folder's own rules
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "gives the lint the same answer for every file"

name: ignored: git is asked about the folder the lint is run in
test: pnpm vitest run addons/strict-lint/tests/rules.test.mts -t "does not judge a file git ignores"

name: ignored: outside a repository git's failure is no list
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "has nothing git ignores"

name: stop hook: a file only .git/info/exclude names is in the hash
test: pnpm vitest run kit/hooks/hooks.test.mts -t "is judged again after a file changes that only .git/info/exclude names"

name: stop hook: a file only a global list names is in the hash
test: pnpm vitest run kit/hooks/hooks.test.mts -t "is judged again after a file changes that only the person"

name: ignored: a file in a package hidden by a rule outside the repository's files is a finding
test: pnpm vitest run kit/gates/git-ignored.test.mts -t "is a finding when the rule is in .git/info/exclude"
